Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark concentric-ringed spots on older leaves, yellowing around spots.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Chlorothalonil or mancozeb spray every 7-10 days (follow the product label).
Tomato___Early_blight.immediate_action: Remove and destroy infected leaves; avoid overhead watering.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Crop rotation, resistant varieties, proper spacing for airflow.
Tomato___Early_blight.severity_guidance: If more than 30% of the leaf area is affected, consider removing the plant.
sources: FAO Plant Health Profiles - Tomato Early Blight, https://www.fao.org/plant-health/tpp/pestsp/Tomato/early-blight/en/, accessed 2026-10-10
